record.oneLiner: Aircall is a cloud phone and call-center platform with a public REST API for calls, numbers, contacts and users.
record.verdictReason: Aircall's public API uses HTTP Basic auth with an api_id and api_token from the dashboard, and OAuth2 for apps. The docs state that direct Messaging API access needs the Professional plan; the docs read did not give a general API plan rule, so paidPlan is the best supported value. No Aircall-hosted MCP server exists; Aircall's docs only describe partners registering their own MCP servers, so the only MCP option is third-party (Composio).

evidence.quote: Public API requests must be authenticated using HTTP Basic Authentication.
Direct API access requires the Professional plan.
Aircall Public API is a classic REST API.
Securely connect your AI agents and chatbots (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc) with Aircall MCP or direct API
